roadmap.goal: Add WhatsApp/Facebook share buttons, copy-link, OG meta tags, and dynamic OG placeholder images to idea detail pages

phases.name: OG Meta Tags and Placeholder Image
phases.description: Foundation layer: create OG image route stub as walking skeleton, add category hex color mapping, restructure idea detail page as server component shell with generateMetadata, then fill in full OG image route and wire placeholder into metadata for ideas without photos

steps.name: OG image route walking skeleton
steps.criteria: route handler returns 200 PNG for existing idea ID

steps.name: categoryOgColors hex mapping with fallback
steps.criteria: all categories mapped to hex, TRANSPORT=cyan, OTHER fallback for unknown

steps.name: generateMetadata emits og:title, og:url, og:description
steps.criteria: og:title, og:description truncated 160 chars, og:url with locale, null idea graceful, empty description fallback

steps.name: generateMetadata emits og:image for ideas with images
steps.criteria: og:image absolute URL for ideas with images, og:image omitted when no images

steps.name: Full OG image route implementation and wire placeholder
steps.criteria: category color background, 404 for missing idea, title truncation, 500 on Prisma error, placeholder og:image for ideas without images

phases.name: Copy Link and Analytics Foundation
phases.description: Build clipboard utility, extend analytics with idea_share event type, create Toaster component, and add share i18n strings

steps.name: copyToClipboard utility with fallback
steps.criteria: writes text returns true, returns false when unavailable, returns false on write failure

steps.name: Analytics event type idea_share
steps.criteria: trackEvent accepts idea_share with channel payload, accepts channel=whatsapp

steps.name: Toaster component and share i18n strings
steps.criteria: Toaster renders sonner, mounted in layout, share i18n keys in ro/hu/en

phases.name: Share Buttons UI
phases.description: Build IdeaShareRow component with WhatsApp, Facebook, and copy buttons including accessible labels, hit targets, popup-blocked fallback, and analytics tracking

steps.name: IdeaShareRow walking skeleton renders all buttons
steps.criteria: renders WhatsApp, Facebook, copy buttons, copy writes utm_source=copy URL, 44x44px hit targets

steps.name: WhatsApp and Facebook intent URLs with UTM
steps.criteria: WhatsApp opens wa.me with utm_source=whatsapp, Facebook opens sharer.php with utm_source=facebook, share text includes title

steps.name: Accessibility, i18n labels, popup fallback
steps.criteria: popup-blocked fallback to copy-link, aria-label i18n labels for all buttons
